Incident brief and difficulty: An application account modifies a user's assigned role or account status even though the operation should be restricted to authorized administrators. (Difficulty: Easy, Est. 15 min)
Owner's root cause and result: Runtime role had table-wide UPDATE granted on app_user. Fixed by revoking table-wide UPDATE and granting column-level UPDATE only on non-sensitive columns (full_name, email, password_hash). Result: Resolved.

Incident brief and difficulty: An administrator deletes an old hazard report, causing its associated status history, maintenance records, assignments, and uploaded evidence to disappear from the database. (Difficulty: Medium, Est. 25 min)
Owner's root cause and result: Foreign keys on dependent audit/history tables configured with ON DELETE CASCADE. Fixed by altering foreign keys to ON DELETE RESTRICT and implementing soft deletion (is_deleted/deleted_at flag). Result: Resolved.

Incident brief and difficulty: An administrator directly changes a hazard report's status through a database management tool, but the corresponding status change does not appear in the report's historical records. (Difficulty: Medium, Est. 25 min)
Owner's root cause and result: Status history tracking was handled at application level without an underlying database trigger. Fixed by creating an AFTER UPDATE trigger on hazard_report that automatically logs status transitions to report_status_history. Result: Resolved.

Variant and activity area: Backup Operator and Disaster Recovery - Activity 6
Incident brief and difficulty: The automated nightly backup job fails with permission denied errors, and generated archives fail integrity validation during restoration drills. (Difficulty: Hard, Est. 30 min)
Owner's root cause and result: Backup operator role campussafe_backup lacked comprehensive read permissions and cluster globals were excluded. Fixed by granting pg_read_all_data to app_backup_grp and automating pg_dumpall --globals-only. Result: Resolved.

Incident brief and difficulty: Administrators encounter multiple duplicate entries representing the same physical room, and maintenance personnel find verified reports lacking priority triage ratings. (Difficulty: Easy, Est. 15 min)
Owner's root cause and result: Table campus_location lacked composite UNIQUE on (building, floor, room_area), and hazard_report permitted status = 'Verified' with NULL priority. Fixed by de-duplicating locations, adding composite UNIQUE, backfilling verified records, and adding conditional CHECK. Result: Resolved.
